newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish net annual income rose 3.32 percent in 1995.
newsitem.headline: Danish net annual income rose 3.32 percent in 1995.

text.p: The average annual net salary of Danes rose 3.32 percent to 111,918 crowns ($16,900) in 1995 from the previous year, Denmark's national statistics office said in a survey published on Tuesday.
The rises for individual groups were 3.04 per cent for wage earners, 3.63 percent for pensioners and 1.40 percent for self-employed, it said.
The office attributed the lower income increase for self-employed to the fact that although they noted higher salary rises than other employee groups, they paid more tax.
